items.summary: Continue existing measurement and attribution reconciliation only. Do not assign the $4.92 aggregate commission to any site or make ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or budget claims; period-aligned operating costs remain unknown.

Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, budget commitment, monetization expansion, forecast, or production work. Revenue evidence supports only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and AI-cost windows are not aligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and approved monthly limits are blank. Minimum measurement is a dated cost ledger reconciled to site/content identifiers and attributable commission, experiment-level cost with incremental outcomes, and owner-approved financial limits. Continue only existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, and repair-or-close work; do not assign aggregate income or treat clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, performance scores, or ordered items as revenue or profit.
